# Weave-mode synthetic mesh fixtures

These meshes are deterministic M10 QA inputs generated by
`scripts/generate_mesh_fixtures.py`. Coordinates are millimetres.

| Fixture | Contract risk it exposes | Analytic or structural facts |
|---|---|---|
| `cylinder.obj` | baseline planar slicing | radius 20 mm, height 30 mm, one ring per interior slice |
| `cone.obj` | changing circumference and area | radius decreases linearly from 24 to 12 mm over 30 mm |
| `bowl.obj` | open-top honesty and radius reversal | radius grows 12→34 mm, then returns to 30 mm |
| `lobed-tumbler.obj` | concave local outward normals | six 30 mm lobes alternate with six 17 mm coves |
| `teapot-lid.obj` | filled interiors on a small tapering solid | shallow dome, radius 26 → 10 mm over 14 mm of height; six 2 mm layers, each one closed ring |
| `tall-tumbler.obj` | rib registration over a long stack | 80 mm tall, radius 29 → 30 → 29 mm; 39 layers at the 2 mm house setting |
| `torus-upright.obj` | island/band changes | horizontal sections form 1→2→1 rings |
| `sphere.obj` | degenerate pole handling | radius 10 mm; near-pole rings exercise `thin_ring` |
| `open-shell.obj` | broken-mesh provenance | 30° vertical wedge removed; every interior slice is open |
| `hollow-cylinder.obj` | nested-loop hole classification | outer radius 30 mm, inner radius 15 mm, height 20 mm |
| `tilted-y-up.obj` | explicit up-axis control | 30 mm axis is +Y in the file; radii taper 7→12 mm |
| `tiny-2mm.stl` | small-input and STL welding path | 2 mm cube; STL repeats facet vertices intentionally |
| `tiny-2mm.3mf` | positive 3MF parser path | same 2 mm cube in a deterministic 3MF package |
| `non-manifold-junk.obj` | non-manifold honesty | three faces share one edge |

`teapot-lid.obj` and `tall-tumbler.obj` are the interior-series pair: a small
lid to fill solid and a tall tumbler to rib with sparse infill. Both place
their profile rings at odd Z so no 2 mm slice plane ever lands on a ring of
vertices, and both taper — the lid steeply, so a centred line set drifts layer
over layer where an anchored one stays put; the tumbler gently, so its ribs
still land on the ribs below.

The over-triangle-budget refusal fixture is not committed. Tests generate a
compact binary PLY in a temporary directory with
`generate_mesh_fixtures.write_over_budget_stress` against a patched small cap
(the shipped bound lives in `clayline.mesh.MAX_TRIANGLES`); the file is
deleted with the test directory.
